description: This Java class defines a GUI component for displaying messages in a text pane, with styling based on message type, and handles incoming messages via an event listener.

classes.name: MessagesView
classes.description: A GUI component for displaying timestamped messages with styling, listening for new messages and appending them to a text pane.

methods.name: MessagesView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message display, styles, and message listener.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message string to the text pane with style based on the message source class.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns a style (bold or italic) based on the class of the message sender.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Removes all messages from the document.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Public method to clear all messages displayed.
